privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How GurePintxo handles your personal data and what rights you have.
privacy.body:
Last updated: 2 October 2026

At GurePintxo we take your privacy seriously. This document explains who is responsible for your data, what data we collect, what we use it for and on what legal basis, who we share it with, and what rights you have over it.

1. Data controller

- Controller: Sergio San Pedro Alvarez.
- Contact email: contacto@gurepintxo.com.

2. Data we collect

- Account data: name, email and password (stored encrypted, never in plain text) when you sign up.
- Profile photo (avatar): if you choose to add one. It is shown next to your name on the reviews you publish.
- Location: if you give us permission, we use your device's location to show you the nearest bars, calculate distances and centre the map. Your location is processed only on your device: we do not send it to our server or store it. You can withdraw this permission at any time from your device settings, although some map features will stop working.
- Content you create: your favourites, the routes you create, the reviews you publish (rating, comment and, if you add them, photos) and the bars you suggest.
- Basic technical data needed for the app to work (for example, the session token that keeps you signed in).

3. What we use your data for and on what legal basis

Performance of the service you request when signing up (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR):
- Creating and managing your account and keeping you signed in.
- Verifying your email when you sign up, through an automated email.
- Saving and showing you your favourites, routes and reviews.
- Showing your reviews publicly to other app users, together with your name and profile photo.
- Handling the bars you suggest.

Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR):
- Location: only if you grant the permission on your device.
- Photos: your profile photo and your review photos, which you upload voluntarily.
You can withdraw your consent at any time by turning off the location permission, deleting the reviews to which you have added photos, or writing to us at contacto@gurepintxo.com to have your profile photo removed, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.

Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR):
- Keeping the app and its users safe and preventing abuse.
- Moderating content: reviewing reported reviews and suggested bars before they are published.

4. Who we share your data with

We do not sell or transfer your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes. To run the app we use the following providers, which process data on our behalf and only to provide their service to us:

- Railway: hosting of the app's server and database.
- Cloudinary: storage of photos (profile photos and review photos).
- Brevo: sending email verification messages.
- Google Maps Platform: displaying maps and searching for bars when you suggest a new one.

Some of these providers are based in the United States or may process data there. In those cases, international transfers are covered by the safeguards provided for in the GDPR: the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, where the provider is certified under it, or the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

5. How long we keep your data

We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account:

- Your personal data (name, email, password and profile photo), your routes and your favourites are deleted.
- Your reviews, their photos and the bars you have suggested are kept anonymously: they are no longer linked to you and appear as "Anonymous".
- In the app you can only delete your reviews: if you do not want them kept, delete them before deleting your account. Suggested bars cannot be deleted in the app; to have them removed, write to us at contacto@gurepintxo.com.

All of the above applies unless the law requires us to keep specific data for a certain period.

6. Your rights

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and data portability at any time:

- In the app: in your Profile you can edit your data and delete your account.
- By email: by writing to us at contacto@gurepintxo.com.

If you believe we have not handled your data properly, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos, www.aepd.es).

7. Minors

GurePintxo is not intended for children under 14 and we do not knowingly collect data from children under that age. If we detect an account belonging to a child under 14, we will delete it.

8. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. If we make significant changes, we will notify you within the app.

9. Contact

If you have any questions about this privacy policy, write to us at contacto@gurepintxo.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms of use of the GurePintxo app.
terms.body:
Last updated: 2 October 2026

By using GurePintxo, you agree to the following terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the app.

1. What GurePintxo is

GurePintxo is a directory of pintxo bars belonging to the Euskadi Gastronomika product club, with map, favourites, custom routes, user reviews and community-suggested bars. The app is run by Sergio San Pedro Alvarez (contacto@gurepintxo.com).

2. Minimum age

You must be at least 14 years old to create an account and use GurePintxo.

3. Your account

- You must provide truthful information when signing up.
- You are responsible for keeping your password confidential.
- Creating accounts in order to impersonate another person or business is not allowed.

4. Content you publish

When you write a review or upload a photo, you keep ownership of that content, but you grant us permission to display it within the app together with your username and profile photo.

Reviews must:
- Reflect your honest opinion and your real experience at the bar.
- Not contain offensive or defamatory language, spam or illegal content.
- Not infringe third-party rights (for example, photos that are not yours).

Any user can report a review they consider inappropriate. Reports are reviewed by the GurePintxo administration, which will decide whether the review is kept or removed.

We reserve the right to remove content that breaches these rules and to suspend accounts that repeatedly breach them.

5. Source of bar data

- Official bars: their data comes from Open Data Euskadi (Basque Government) and is reused in accordance with its licence. Source: Open Data Euskadi, Basque Government (CC BY 4.0 licence).
- Community-suggested bars: they are located using Google Maps. Each suggestion goes through a review process before being published, and we do not guarantee that every suggestion will be accepted.

6. Permitted use of the app

You may not:
- Try to access other users' data without authorisation.
- Use the app for purposes other than those intended (for example, mass data scraping).
- Interfere with the normal operation of the app or its servers.

7. Service availability

GurePintxo is provided "as is". We do our best to keep bar information up to date, but we do not guarantee that the data (opening hours, address, etc.) is always accurate; we recommend confirming directly with the bar if in doubt.

8. Account deletion

You can delete your account at any time from your Profile. When you do, your personal data, your routes and your favourites are deleted. Your reviews, their photos and the bars you have suggested are kept anonymously and appear as "Anonymous". In the app you can only delete your reviews: if you do not want them kept, delete them before deleting your account. To have the bars you have suggested removed, write to us at contacto@gurepintxo.com. You will find more details in our Privacy Policy.

9. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the app after a change means you accept the new terms.

10. Governing law

These terms are governed by Spanish law, without prejudice to any rights you may have under applicable consumer protection law.

11. Contact

For any questions about these terms, write to us at contacto@gurepintxo.com.
